name: Black Waves, Lesser
body:
School necromancy; Level death mage 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 15 ft.

Aura cone-shaped burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You release waves of black necromantic energy. Any creature in the area takes 1d4 points of negative energy damage per caster level (maximum 5d4). Undead within the area instead heal 1 damage per caster level (maximum 5).
